correctness.rationale: For the equal-radius intersection of three infinite perpendicular right cylinders, the radial section function on central plane n⊥ is ρ(u)²=R²/(1-min_i u_i²). Switching between constituent ellipses occurs at u_i=s u_j (s=±1) only when |n_k|<|n_i+s n_j|; the switch is transverse for generic nonzero normal coordinates. Sorting a>=b>=c>0 shows exactly three active unoriented switching lines if a<b+c and four if a>b+c, giving six/eight genuine curved arcs, not polygonal sides. On each angular sector the polar area integral is R²/2∫dθ/(1-u_i²), and the oriented linear map with determinant |n_i| transforms it to an atan2 angle divided by |n_i|. Consecutive sector widths are <π and this fixes arctangent branch, yielding an explicit globally finite formula. The eight-arc normal chamber is union of 24 congruent spherical triangles of solid angle 2 arctan(3-2√2), hence P8=12/π arctan(3-2√2). Degenerate planes are excluded from generic arc count; area extends continuously.
